headline: The Pen That Saved the Apollo 11 Moon Mission Just Sold for $857K
reasoning: This topic scores highly due to its immense clickability and mainstream appeal, combining space history, a near-disaster, and a clever low-tech solution that saved the mission. While its direct practical value is low, its inspirational quality and incredible versatility for different formats—from listicles ('5 Low-Tech Hacks That Saved High-Tech Missions') to deep explainers—make it a perfect fit for our audience of enthusiasts and builders.
summary: The felt-tip pen and broken switch that Buzz Aldrin used to repair the Apollo 11 ascent engine, averting a potential disaster on the Moon, have been sold at auction for $857,600.

source_articles.title: Buzz Aldrin sells famous felt-tip pen that helped launch Apollo from the Moon
source_articles.excerpt: While an impressive sale, the pen and switch did not break records.
